# Sanity queries

The GROQ queries that ask Sanity for content. Each file exports a query object that `../queries.js` collects.

## What's here

- Folders per content type (`project/`, `award/`, `organization/`, and so on)
- `home.js`, `contact.js`, `user-guide.js`: single-page queries

## How it connects

- Shared field lists come from [projections](../projections/README.md).
- Results are shaped by [transforms](../transforms/README.md).
